criteria.evidence: server/tests/storage-access.test.ts ('criterion 1') runs the local implementation behind a real HTTP server: the original without a signature answers 404 with no content, a signed link answers 200 with private, no-store, and an expired link, a link with a forged expiry and a signature issued for another key all answer 403. Removing the public-access check from gateway.ts makes all 6 access scenarios fail. CI run 35577671525 green on 3af35d79.

server/tests/storage-access.test.ts ('criterion 2'): the public variant of a published article's cover answers 200, after the article is archived the same URL answers 404, after restoring to published it answers 200 again; the same file closes the avatar of an archived account and the media of a draft. Access is re-resolved from Prisma on every request, so there is no cached open state. CI run 35577671525 green on 3af35d79.
